text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Shakur. How's it hangin'?
I came to visit Triple Crown Island!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "After all, I was free! Shall we dance?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, coming here for such a trivial reason.
You imaginary number.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Huh? Imaginary number...?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. In this Satsuki Sho,
you weren't supposed to be here, Tap.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even if you weren't here,
she was planned to be here anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...For a split second, I thought Air Shakur glared at me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then again, it might just be my imagination.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The one meant to partner with that Trainer was a different Umamusume.
That was Parcae's definitive judgment.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And furthermore, that 'she couldn't produce results.'
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Wherever things went wrong,
she met you, and then—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Because of that, this Satsuki Sho is utter chaos.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's not a single thing I'm certain of.
I never imagined it would come to this.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hmph, not a single certain thing, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: That's not necessarily true, Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's that about?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Trainer told me. This race—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"You're my only target.
As long as I beat you,
the results will follow!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Is she reading them... the numbers?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I should be the only one who can see it.
And yet—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Very well.
Come, Tap."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna let you guys have your way.
The outcome here is already set in stone!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You say it's obvious...
Come on, don't be a buzzkill.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Races are always unpredictable, right?! You've gotta enjoy the thrill to the fullest!"
